entities.summary: Alfred John Rogers is a Canadian former professional ice hockey winger who played 14 games in the National Hockey League for the Minnesota North Stars during the 1973–74 and 1974–75 seasons. He also played 44 games in the World Hockey Association with the Edmonton Oilers during the 1975–76 season.
